title: Letter Dated April 1, 1933, Addressed To Shanghai

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 10,000-6-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. H. REGISTRY
S.2.Sp. Br / Stations /
REPORT
Date May / 15 / 1933

Subject (in full) Letter dated April 1, 1933, addressed to Shanghai Municipal
Police re Chinese female communist named Chao Yu Tse (赵雨滋)
Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached confidential
despatch, character "Fah" (法), No.373, dated April 1, 1933,
addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Police from General Wen
Hung-en, Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, on the
subject of a Chinese female communist named Chao Yu Tse
(赵雨滋), believed to be the Secretary-General and concurrently
Chief of the Training Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, who is reported
to be taking an active part in the communist movement in
Shanghai, I have to report that diligent enquiries made by
the Chinese staff of this Section with a view to tracing
her whereabouts have so far been unsuccessful.

Chao Chi Nieh (赵赤聂), brother of the aforementioned
communist, was arrested in September 1927 at Hankow, on a
charge of propagating communism, and was summarily executed
by the Hankow Authorities.

The particulars relating to Chao Yu Tse have
been recorded for future reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

[签名]
MAY 15. 1933.

发自 2
G. 10,000-6-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. H. 登记处
S.2.特别处 / 各警署 /
报告
日期 1933年5月15日

主题（全称） 关于1933年4月1日致上海公共租界工部局警务处的信函，涉及一名名为赵雨滋的中国女共产党员
由特别处督察顾宝华呈报 转呈人 [签名]

兹提及随函附上的机密公函，法字第373号，日期为1933年4月1日，由上海市公安局局长文鸿恩将军致上海公共租界工部局警务处，主题涉及一名名为赵雨滋的中国女共产党员，据信其为中国共产党江苏省委员会秘书长兼训练部部长，据报道其在上海的共产主义运动中表现活跃。本人谨此报告，本处华籍职员为追踪其下落已进行勤勉查访，但迄今未有结果。

上述共产党员之兄赵赤聂，于1927年9月在汉口因传播共产主义罪名被捕，并被汉口当局就地正法。

有关赵雨滋的详细资料已记录在案，以备日后参考。

顾宝华
特别处督察

特别处处长。

[签名]
1933年5月15日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P.
C. & S. B. REGIST.
N. D 4717
Date 3 / 4 / 33

April 3, 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No. 373 of April 1, regarding a female communist leader
named Chao Yu Tse (趙玉芝) native of Hupeh who is said
to be very active in communistic circles in Shanghai,
and to inform you that the matter will receive attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.

General Wen Hung-en,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

复者准四月一日法字
第三七三号密函以援
报有女共首领赵玉
芝一名湖北人现在上海
颇为活动函请查缉由
准此现已饬属侦查矣
相应函复即希
查照可荷此致
上海市公安局局长文
警务部长贾
(Sd) F. W. G......

S2,
For inquiry
and report
please.
APR. 5 1933
S. Kuh. For attention. Sd 5/4

1933年4月3日。

先生：

兹确认收到阁下4月1日第373号来函，关于一名名为赵玉芝（趙玉芝）的湖北籍女共产党首领，据悉其在上海共产主义圈子中极为活跃，并告知阁下此事将予以关注。

此致，

阁下恭顺的仆人，

(签署) F. W. Garrard
警务处长。

上海市公安局局长文鸿恩将军，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REGIS
No. D 4717
14-103
Translation of confidential despatch, character
No.373 of April 1, 1933, in re the apprehension
Chao Yu Tse, female communist leader from the public
Safety Bureau.

Police Department,
S. M. C.
Gentlemen,
I have to inform you confidentially that a
report has been recently received from our specially
deputed officer Wang Yung Hwa (黃永華) to the
effect that one female communist leader named Chao
Yu Tse (趙玉芝), over 30 years of age, native of
Hupeh, is at present very active in communistic
activities in Shanghai. She is the Secretary-General
and concurrently the Chief of the Instruction Office
of the Communistic Organization of Kiangsu Province.
She is the sister of the communist leader Chao Chi
Nieh (趙啟嚴) who has already been apprehended and
convicted. She is plumply built and has a round face,
her complexion is of brown colour, with round eyes and
swollen and thick upper eyelids, and has some small red
freckles on her bottom eyelids, with two deformed feet.
Her presence is very clandestine, and therefore it is
very difficult to locate her present whereabouts.
Apart from instructing our men to make arrest
of the abovenamed, I am notifying you of the above that
you will kindly instruct your subordinates to keep a sharp
lookout of this culprit.

(Chopped) Wen Hung-en
Chief of Public Safety Bureau.

Reg.
Please prepare formal
reply and pass to
Commissioner of Police
Wangin.
APR. 3 1933

上海公共租界
刑事侦缉处登记处
No. D 4717
14-103
翻译自公安局关于逮捕女共产党首领赵玉芝的1933年4月1日法字第373号机密公函。

致：
工部局警务处，
诸位先生：
兹机密告知，我方特派员黄永华近日提交报告称，一名名为赵玉芝（趙玉芝）的女共产党首领，年龄三十余岁，湖北籍，目前在上海的共产主义活动中极为活跃。她是共产党江苏省组织秘书长兼教导部主任。她系已被捕并定罪的共产党首领赵启严（趙啟嚴）之妹。该人体态丰满，圆脸，肤色呈褐色，圆眼，上眼睑肿胀且厚，下眼睑有一些红色小雀斑，双足畸形。其行踪极为隐秘，因此很难确定其当前下落。
除指令我方人员逮捕上述人员外，特将此情通知贵方，恳请贵方指令下属对此罪犯保持严密监视。

（盖章）文鸿恩
公安局局长。

登记处。
请拟正式
回复并送交
警务处长
Wangin.
1933年4月3日
